Confirmed as a missing supplier link and duplicate generic planning, with a corrected implementation of the proposed fix. GMR v3 (4.4), p.35, and §4.3, pp.39–40 (Annals p.797), require a Tauberian passage. The accepted PAPER-WOOD-19/286 and route 10 already assign the nondecreasing Laplace theorem, including pole order m=1 and positive abscissa, to Arithmetic Dirichlet series and Tauberian methods, Part II. For fixed w, N(w,·) is nonnegative, nondecreasing and locally finite; its positive waiting times and branch weights give convergence right of β, and the spectral theorems give continuation across Re s=β away from β. With νβ(1)=νβ(hβ)=1, the simple-pole coefficient of s⁻¹(1−L_s)⁻¹1 is hβ(w)/(β|λ′β|). The branch expansion ratio ≥3/2 supplies λ′β<0, not strict monotonicity alone. Import the scalar theorem from WOOD/286 and keep the application, residue and uniform-in-w renewal estimate in GMR route 3. Continuity of the residue plus pointwise asymptotics does not itself prove uniformity: retain an explicit proof obligation for uniform analytic/contour estimates or a uniform Tauberian adapter. Do not put the proposed roadmap id alone in planned (it is not a stage id), and do not route a duplicate scalar theorem to route 3. Until a supplier stage exists, use a prerequisite/gap and maintainer dependency note identifying WOOD/286, its accepted route 10 and the canonical DESIGN-ArithmeticDirichletSeriesPartII; preserve the old proposed id as an alias.

Confirmed at the pinned source trees. ContDiffMapSupportedIn, Analysis/Distribution/ContDiffMapSupportedIn.lean:97–101, requires a globally Cⁿ map vanishing outside K, so with K=∆ it cannot supply the constant-one element of C¹(∆). Tau Ceti f790474, Analysis/CompletelyMonotone/Laplace/Representation.lean:73, supplies a real-parameter transform of measures on ℝ≥0, not the complex two-sided function transform in GMR p.34. The cited spectralRadius and real p-series declarations do exist; Complex.summable_one_div_nat_cpow also exists at Analysis/PSeriesComplex.lean:25. Replace the two unsupported imports by explicit construction/supplier obligations: C¹ on a compact convex body in its affine span, with norm, completeness and composition API; and the complex transform, convergence, holomorphy and renewal identity. Reuse the Tauberian supplier's Laplace convention rather than creating two generic transforms. A Mellin adapter is possible: for g(t)=f(log t), Laplace(f,s)=mellin(g,−s), with the change-of-variables and integrability proofs. Do not infer these adapters are already built, or re-plan the existing real-measure Laplace API.

Confirmed. Item 30 is entirely marked planned at ProbabilisticAndMetricNumberTheory:PM.4, but the stage only specifies the Gauss map, invariant measure, ergodicity/mixing and metric continued fractions; its packet has not_read coverage and no PM.4 nodes. GMR v3 Examples 32/35, pp.35–36, additionally require the parameter-dependent conjugacy, and p.37 invokes a version of the RPF theorem. Directly, with T_A(x)=1/(x+A+1), the GMR weight is ((x+1)/(x+A+2))^s and multiplication by (x+1)^s conjugates it to (x+A+1)^(-s). This is valid on Re s>1 with positive real bases; the proposed real-s>1 subcase is also sound. Split the PM.4-owned base Gauss map and normalized invariant probability density 1/((1+x)log 2) from the missing conjugacy and precise function-space spectral theorem, and route those latter items once to route 3. The unnormalized eigenfunction 1/(1+x) and the probability density must remain distinct.

Confirmed as an incomplete prerequisite register, but correct the bibliographic equivalence in the claim. GMR v3 pp.35,40–42 explicitly use Baladi, Pollicott's Lemmas 2.1/2.3, ITM50 and PP90 Theorem 2.2; p.20 cites Lalley 1988. None has an entry among the extraction's 14 prerequisites. However, the Annals references on p.808 identify [Pol14] as Apollonian circle packings (2014), while [Pol] is Statistical properties of the Rauzy–Veech–Zorich map. The published body cites [Pol14] for the Jacobian and RPF arguments at pp.797/799. Thus the finding's statement that the Rauzy notes are renamed [Pol14] is false. Record the original v3 Rauzy citation, the published label/title discrepancy, and the exact version actually used; do not silently equate them. The public teichmuller-survey7.pdf is a later Aimino–Pollicott text and cannot be treated as the original solely because its title matches. Add PP90 and ITM50 with their precise roles, identify the chosen direct/cone RPF route, and distinguish Baladi's background reference and Lalley 1988's historical precursor from indispensable dependencies. Listing sources does not discharge the countably-many-branches adaptation or certify that the finite-type theorem applies unchanged.

Confirmed by inspecting the page images of arXiv v3 p.46 and Annals Table 1, p.804. The absolute column sum calculated from the corrected matrix is (Σ_{k≠i}w_k + 1−w_i+β(w))/(2−w_i)²=(1+2β(w)−2w_i)/(2−w_i)², agreeing with the subsequent formula. Hence this typo does not alter (5.1). Add a separately identified misprint scoped to both versions, with the two locators and correction, and update item 43. E18 is free in the reviewed extraction; preserve stable issue ids if another correction has appeared before the fix. The searched publisher/title records supplied no correction, so any known:new entry must retain that dated search scope.
